summary_en: The company expanded its share buyback authorization from 7.5 million shares (300 million yen) to 12 million shares (5 billion yen), representing 5.16% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The acquisition period was extended from October 29, 2026 to March 31, 2027, with purchases to be executed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The expansion follows early completion of the previous 3 billion yen authorization on July 15, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Expansion of Share Buyback Framework and Extension of Acquisition Period
translation_en_brief:
On October 2, 2026, Hankyu Hanshin Holdings expanded and extended its share buyback program. The company increased the acquisition authorization from 750 million yen maximum (7.5 million shares, 3.14% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) to 5 billion yen maximum (12 million shares, 5.16% of outstanding shares). The acquisition period was extended from the original end date of October 29, 2026 to March 31, 2027. All purchases will continue to be executed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange through market transactions at the board's discretion based on market conditions and legal constraints.

The expansion follows the early completion of the previous 3 billion yen buyback authorization, which acquired 6.547 million shares by July 15, 2026. This action is part of the company's medium- to long-term capital allocation strategy, which targets a cumulative total payout ratio of 50% or higher for fiscal years 2025 through 2030. The company stated that the expansion aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while maintaining sound financial health and pursuing investments for medium- to long-term growth.
